description: UX B p.3 (olife_menu, 16.10): whitelist by nick. One supervisor DB (account_settings _wl:<gateway id>), three ways to manage it: the admin's chat `/whitelist on|add|list` (world -> daemon over HTTP, OpResult, op line, audit), a player's /whitelist -> 16, CLI (`lab olife whitelist` = feature olife.whitelist), the panel button (POST /call/olife.whitelist via=panel), the lab op (`lab olife op whitelist ...`). Then logins from the client's menu by nick (no token): listed -> play; unlisted -> status screen «нет в вайтлисте» -> add -> Повторить -> play; whitelist off -> any free nick plays. The account token never goes into the game socket (tickets; the gateway takes tickets and, for the protocol chat clients of this test, static tokens: auth_mode both).
